name: appointment_cancel
description: appointment_cancel: Cancel a registered record and roll back the source residual number of the corresponding number.

appointment_id.description: The registration number to be canceled, such as AP202609280001, comes from the registration results or query results.

name: appointment_create
description: appointment_create: Register for the current conversation patient and occupy a number source.

slot_id.description: The source identification of the account to be hung must come from the return result of appointment_query_slots. Do not make it up by yourself.

appointment_id.description: The registered number is like AP202609280001. If it is omitted, it will return all the registered records of this session.

name: appointment_query_slots
description: appointment_query_slots: Query the source and residual number of the registered number of a department.

department_id.description: Department identification, must use candidate return or confirmed department_id。

date.description: Date of consultation, format YYYY-MM-DD. If it is omitted, it will return to all the appointments available dates.

doctor_id.description: Doctor's logo. It is transmitted when the patient names a doctor; if it is omitted, it will return to the number source of all doctors in the department.

period.description: Time: morning = morning, afternoon = afternoon. There is no limit to omission.

name: patient_get_profile
description: patient_get_profile: Read the patient information recorded in this session.

name: patient_update_profile
description: patient_update_profile: Record or update the basic information of the patient in this session.

phone.description: Mainland China mobile phone number, 11 digits. Fill in the optional.

name: triage_check_red_flags
description: triage_check_red_flags: Red flag symptom screening (compulsory gate).

text.description: The patient's original oral description of discomfort in this round is transmitted as it is. Do not rewrite, delete or add medical judgment.

symptoms.description: Optional. If the normalized symptom words have been extracted from the conversation (such as ["headache", "dizziness"]), they will be transmitted together; leave it blank when it is uncertain, and only pass text。

name: triage_query_department
description: triage_query_department: Inquire about the business scope, outpatient location and pre-treatment preparation tips of individual departments.

department_id.description: Department identification. You must use the department_id in the candidate return, and do not use the English display name of the department.

name: triage_shortlist_departments
description: triage_shortlist_departments: According to the symptoms, candidate departments (up to 3) can be selected.

symptoms.description: A list of normalized symptom words extracted from the dialogue, such as ["fever", "cough"]. Use standardized symptom words, and don't pass them into the whole sentence.

age.description: The age of the patient (years old). It must be introduced when it is known: the election meeting at the age of 14 is forcibly converged to pediatrics. It can be omitted when it is unknown.

max_candidates.description: The maximum number of candidate departments is 3 by default. Usually there is no need to pass it in.
